phase: Post-baseline follow-up; frozen before this selection experiment.
selection: Released metadata-only 42 series, all three released models; widths 30, 100, 300. Width 300 is an explicit stress regime.
contract: Return all models within 1e-10 of the maximum exact PR. Certificate-first uses 3e-10 numerical separation, then exact fallback for unresolved candidates. No-pruning ablation falls back to all three models when unresolved.
timing: Whole three-model calls including validation, preprocessing, bounds and fallback. Loading precomputed scores and JIT warmup excluded. One thread; randomized method order, three repetitions.
scope: Numerically audited selection on frozen inputs, not a formal outward-rounded Float64 certificate or detector training speedup.
fixed250: Speed/decision-error comparator, not an exact-contract baseline.
